text: Deferred deliberately at 2026-08-29 03:55Z while ruling on bd-01M15844GFA2WPFG4WFZCSDVZN. Finding (codex-storymodel4s-scout, post-01M15T7AR7ZW195E304905YYA9): sensitivity is not reachable where embed-grakern builds ProviderCall receipts. PreparedSources holds checked charts + checksums; StructuralDistance.apply receives PropositionEvidence; PropositionEvidence carries chart + ChartProvenance; provenance is origin/receipts/alternatives. Origin cannot imply sensitivity because both a public fixture and researcher-reviewed participant material can be Hand. Chief ruled the NARROW fix for now: embed-grakern-owned receipt context captured by construction, carrying source/query Sensitivity + SensitiveKeyProvider, no implicit public default, one declared sensitivity per distance instance (mixing refused at construction; ambiguity fails toward keyed, since treating sensitive material as public is a breach while treating public as sensitive costs only reproducibility). THE OPEN QUESTION THIS BEAD HOLDS: should PropositionEvidence itself carry a portable Sensitivity, so every consumer of evidence - not just embed-grakern - knows what it is holding? That is new cross-module public vocabulary and an ADR-level decision about the shape of evidence, so it was not made at 04:00 to unblock one receipt field. Reopen with evidence if the narrow fix proves insufficient: the signal would be a SECOND provider needing the same context and having to re-derive it, or a consumer outside embed-grakern making a plain-vs-keyed decision it cannot ground. Relates to ADR 0001 D6 and the always-under-K law.
